## Pull Request Overview This PR enhances the version parsing logic for Microsoft Visual Studio compiler detection to handle non-standard version formats. The change makes the parsing more robust by extracting only the leading digits from each version component using regex, and includes bounds checking to prevent index errors. - Adds regex-based digit extraction for version components instead of direct integer conversion - Adds bounds checking before accessing `sem_ver` array elements - Gracefully handles malformed version strings by defaulting to -1
